translations.source:
The floating license server is a program that can hand out leases to clients running JangaFX products.
A lease is a license that is acquired for the duration of a user session or until the user manually releases
the lease. The floating server needs to be activated using a floating license that permits the server to hand out
a given number of leases.
translations.target: 浮动许可证服务器是一个程序，可向运行 JangaFX 产品的客户端发放租约。租约是在用户会话期间取得的许可证，直到用户手动释放租约为止。浮动服务器需要使用浮动许可证激活，该许可证允许服务器发放指定数量的租约。

This command will install the service to run with the provided options. These are the same options used to run the server directly.
The installed service will expect the executable to be located at the same path it was at the time of installation. If you move the executable
to a different directory, you will need to uninstall and reinstall the service to update its path. The service will be configured to run on system startup.
